name: scarecrow
description: Off-grid AI sentry: vision + rules + spoken alerts on a Raspberry Pi ≤4GB

scripts.start: python3 scripts/seed.py && node --import 'data:text/javascript,import { register } from "node:module"; import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"; register("ts-node/esm", pathToFileURL("./"));' src/web/server.ts
scripts.sentry: node --import 'data:text/javascript,import { register } from "node:module"; import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"; register("ts-node/esm", pathToFileURL("./"));' src/core/power.ts
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
